text: HomestayHanoi - About your home HomestayHanoi - 22A Hue street, Hanoi, Vietnam Home Apartments Services Location About HomestayHanoi Contact FAQs About your home Hanoi Homestay offers extended stay tenants an opportunity to experience Vietnamese hospitality and culture with the friendly host family of an experienced English language teacher and senior interpreter. Hanoi Homestay is located in Hanoi’s center, over 500 meters from Hoan Kiem Lake, in Pho Hue street. Shopping boutiques, restaurants & food courts, cafeterias, green parks and lakes, cinemas, theatres, pagodas, churches, banks and urban amenities are all in the neighborhood. It is also surrounded by dozens of embassies, UN agencies, World Bank, diplomatic residences, 5-star hotels and ministerial head offices, … say, in walking distance. Hanoi Homestay offers three studio rooms and three 2-floor apartments with furniture and facilities best convenient possible to tenants. In each accommodation unit you will find large windows with green houseplants, plus a private bathroom. Located in Pho Hue street, the residence is quiet with its Tuscan design both exterior and interior. Morning coffee is to be best enjoyed in rooftop garden fresh air. About our home Environmental friendly and inspired by Tuscan interior design, Hanoi Homestay is a garden building offering its cosy apartments to all international friends who come to experience Vietnamese culture and lifestyle during their work assignment in Vietnam. Our family, mother tongued in Vietnamese, can all speak English, and you can dramatically improve you communication skills in Vietnamese through daily conversations and involvement in the Vietnamese lifestyle and community. We can help you adjust to the lifestyle in Hanoi city, introduce you to the neighborhood, give you good safety tips, and offer you clean private and quiet accommodation during you stay in Hanoi. © 2011 - Homestay Hanoi Address: 22A Hue street, Hanoi, Vietnam - Cellphone : 0914373441
